classes.pure: Read-only/static validation; no temporary tree, hardware or signals
classes.filesystem: May create an owned mktemp tree and child tools; never signals or touches hardware
classes.process: Exercises supervision or signals and is permitted only inside the sealed user/PID/mount namespace
classes.hardware: May observe a real device/backend and is never part of an automatic host gate

signals: HUP, INT and TERM direct generated launcher before game start
TERM plus immediate HUP or post-forward INT direct generated launcher during supervised game
signal 0 liveness probe for direct generated launcher test child
TERM direct child from generated launcher after PID and starttime validation
KILL direct child from generated launcher after bounded grace and PID and starttime validation
KILL direct generated launcher test child on behavioral watchdog timeout
TERM exact child with PID and starttime
KILL exact child with PID and starttime after bounded grace
TERM exact inspector-test child through pidfd
KILL exact inspector-test child through pidfd after bounded grace
KILL direct exact inspector child on pidfd acquisition or supervisor setup failure
signal 0 liveness probe for direct guest-gate selftest sibling
TERM direct guest-gate selftest sibling owned by Popen
KILL direct guest-gate selftest sibling owned by Popen after bounded grace
TERM exact nxandroid signal-test child through pidfd
KILL exact nxandroid signal-test child through pidfd after bounded grace
TERM direct unrelated video sentinel child spawned by the launcher behavior gate after its PID and starttime identity is revalidated
TERM direct readelf child owned by the inventory supervisor
KILL direct readelf child owned by the inventory supervisor after bounded grace
SIGSEGV exact nxobs crash-fixture child re-raised by its installed handler
SIGABRT exact nxobs crash-fixture child re-raised by its installed handler
signal 0 liveness probe for direct generated-launcher child of the real-crash rollback gate
TERM direct generated-launcher child of the real-crash rollback gate after PID and starttime validation
KILL direct generated-launcher child of the real-crash rollback gate after bounded grace
ABRT and TERM self-raised by the fake guest of the real-crash rollback gate to reproduce exit 134/143
